Ajay Giri Goswami 
Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India 
+91-86020-35235 | ag124767@gmail.com | Linkedin  | GitHub | Portfolio 
 
Profile Summary 
Full Stack Developer (MERN) with hands-on experience building scalable web applications using MongoDB, Express.js, React.js, and 
Node.js. Skilled in REST API development, API integration, JWT-based authentication, and responsive UI design. Experienced in e-
commerce operations, performance analytics, and SEO optimization. Strong problem-solving ability with focus on clean, maintainable, 
and efficient code..
 
Technical Skills 
 Frontend : HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React.js, Redux, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design . 
 Backend : Node.js, Express.js, REST API Development, API Integration, JWT Authentication . 
 Database : MongoDB, Mongoose, MySQL. 
 Tools : Git, GitHub, npm, Axios, Chart.js, Excel  
 
Education 
 Master of Computer Application (MCA) – Pursuing, Sage University, Indore. 
 Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) – Vishisht School of Management, April 2021 - June 2024     CGPA:   6.62/10 
 
Experience 
Aquadpure –E-Commerce Account Manger                                                                                                     Duration: (Feb 2025 - Present) 
 Managed 150+ product listings across Amazon and Flipkart, handling pricing, inventory, and FBA operations  
 Improved product visibility and keyword ranking through SEO optimization, increasing impressions and 
conversions 
 Reduced ACOS by optimizing ad campaigns and improving targeting strategies  
 Analyzed sales data and performance metrics to drive data-driven decisions and improve revenue efficiency 
 Streamlined inventory tracking and order processing workflows for better operational efficiency
 
Projects 
Profit & RTO Simulation Calculator                                                                                                                                              Demo Link   
 Developed a web-based Amazon profit calculator handling referral fees, closing fees, and 1% TCS  
 Implemented Return-to-Origin (RTO) loss scenarios including double shipping cost impact  
 Designed interactive dashboards using Chart.js to visualize revenue, cost, and profit trends  
 Integrated automated PDF report generation using jsPDF 
 Built responsive UI for seamless user experience across devices 
Tech Stack: HTML, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Chart.js, jsPDF 
 
Multi-Platform Stock Management System (MERN Stack)                                                                                                  Demo Link                        
 Built a full-stack inventory management system supporting multi-platform stock tracking 
 Implemented real-time stock updates for sales and purchase transactions using REST APIs  
 Developed low-stock alert system to prevent inventory shortages 
 Enabled bulk product uploads via Excel import, improving data handling efficiency  
 Designed scalable backend architecture with modular structure and JWT -based authentication 
 Tech Stack: React.js, Redux Toolkit, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, Mongoose, JWT Authentication, 
REST APIs, Axios
